commands.name: search-genomes
commands.summary: Search genome assemblies by name. Can list every assembly of one species by taxonomy id, and can sort (e.g. by contig N50) and paginate.

commands.name: export-genomes-csv
commands.summary: Download genome search results as CSV text, matching search-genomes for the same query.

commands.name: get-genome
commands.summary: Get metadata for one genome by its UUID: assembly, providers, annotation version/date, release and reference status.

commands.name: get-genome-stats
commands.summary: Get statistics for a genome: assembly (N50, length, GC%), coding, non-coding, pseudogene and variation counts.

commands.name: get-genome-example-objects
commands.summary: Get example gene, location and variant ids for a genome. These are handy starting points for gene and variant lookups.

commands.name: list-popular-species
commands.summary: List popular species with their taxonomy id and number of available genomes.

commands.name: list-genome-groups
commands.summary: List genome group categories, such as external projects like VGP and BGE, with genome counts.

commands.name: get-genome-counts
commands.summary: Get the total number of genomes in Ensembl and the count per taxonomic group (Animals, Archaea, …).

commands.name: list-releases
commands.summary: List Ensembl data releases (name, type integrated/partial, is_current).

commands.name: search-genes
commands.summary: Search genes by symbol, name or stable id within one genome. Returns stable ids, biotype and location.

commands.name: search-variants
commands.summary: Search variants (e.g. by rsID) within one genome.

commands.name: get-gene-summary
commands.summary: Get a gene's versioned stable id, symbol, chromosome location, strand and biotype.

commands.name: get-gene-overview
commands.summary: Get a gene's full name, alternative symbols (synonyms), HGNC accession and biotype.

commands.name: get-gene-structure
commands.summary: Get a gene's transcripts with exon layout, CDS coordinates, protein product ids and canonical/MANE flags. This is what the feature explorer gene view draws.

commands.name: list-gene-transcripts
commands.summary: List all transcripts of a gene with biotype, length, canonical/MANE status and protein length. Also returns the gene location and region checksum.

commands.name: get-gene-external-references
commands.summary: Get cross-references (NCBI Gene, HGNC, OMIM, GeneCards, UniProt, RefSeq, …) for a gene and for each of its transcripts and proteins.

commands.name: get-gene-homologies
commands.summary: List homologues/orthologues of a gene in other species, with homology type and percent identity/coverage.

commands.name: get-transcript
commands.summary: Get one transcript's location, exons, CDS coordinates and protein product (id, length, sequence checksum).

commands.name: get-protein-domains
commands.summary: Get a protein's length and its domain/family matches (Pfam, PANTHER, InterPro, …) with positions.

commands.name: get-protein-structure-stats
commands.summary: Get PDBe summary counts for a UniProt accession: number of PDB structures, ligands, interaction partners and similar proteins.

commands.name: get-variant
commands.summary: Get variant details: location, alleles, allele type, dbSNP source, VEP prediction, citation count, phenotype assertions and population allele frequencies.

commands.name: get-variant-consequences
commands.summary: Get the predicted molecular consequences of each allele of a variant on overlapping transcripts: consequence terms plus cDNA, CDS and protein positions with ref/alt.

commands.name: get-region
commands.summary: Get a chromosome/region's length, topology and sequence checksum. Use the checksum with get-sequence.

commands.name: get-sequence
commands.summary: Fetch raw DNA or protein sequence (plain text) for a sequence checksum over a coordinate range, via refget. Uses 0-based start and exclusive end.

dropped.name: get-help-menu
dropped.reason: Output is the help navigation menu tree, not site data, and no command fetches the article content.
